purpose: Verify source metadata for the retained-anchor side of the 96 explicitly unverified legacy pair IDs.
method: Parsed original-batch CSV records with quoted-field and embedded-newline support. Retained locations were taken from retain, retain_candidate or a; the combined federalism anchor was checked at both physical source locations.
limits: Source metadata does not establish whether a row was introduced or changed by a later Git commit.
The 96 pair IDs remain unverified in the register until row-level Git history is checked and cluster membership reconciled.
